items.stem: Your conference trip comes to $3,200. Who approves the claim?

options.feedback: A manager approves claims up to $1,000 only.
Right: directors approve claims up to $5,000.
The CFO approves claims above $5,000; $3,200 is below that.

items.explanation: Manager up to $1,000, director up to $5,000, CFO above $5,000 (Expense Policy §4.7).
items.scenario: You just came back from a two-day conference. Flights, hotel and meals add up to $3,200.

items.stem: You paid $48 for a work lunch with a client and only have your card statement. Can you claim it as it is?

options.text: Yes, the card statement proves the payment
options.feedback: A card statement alone is not a receipt.

options.text: No, you need the itemised receipt
options.feedback: Correct: expenses over $25 need an itemised receipt.

options.text: Yes, receipts are only needed over $100

items.explanation: A receipt is required for every expense over $25, and a card statement alone is not a receipt (§3, §4.1).

items.stem: Put the claim steps in order.

options.text: Photograph the receipt the same day
Open Northwind Expenses and select New Claim
Enter category, date, amount and purpose
Attach the receipt photo and check the total
Submit the claim to your approver

items.explanation: This is the order of the claim procedure in the Expense Policy.

items.stem: A claim submitted 100 days after the expense will still be reimbursed.

options.feedback: No: claims older than 90 days are not reimbursed.
Correct: submit within 30 days; after 90 days claims are not paid.
